-# PHOENIX STATS · HELP
## Step by step
-# Some jobs need more than one command. Do them in this order.

**Your end-of-season Rush card**
**1.** `/seasoncard scan` – Attach a screenshot of your Rush season stats.
**2.** `Check the reading` – The bot shows what it read. Wrong numbers? Press Edit on the site instead.
**3.** `Save my card` – Saves it and posts it in the season channel. You have 15 minutes, or press Discard.
**4.** `/seasoncard mine` – Shows your saved card and where you rank.

**The club Rush ladder (managers)**
**1.** `/rushladder scan` – Attach a photo of the Rush leaderboard.
**2.** `It reads and saves` – If the photo is clear it saves and posts. If not, it says what to fix and sends you to the site.
**3.** `/rushladder latest` – Shows the most recent ladder.

**Find a player**
**1.** `/player` – Start typing a gamertag, pick it, get the stats card.
**2.** `/compare` – Put two players side by side.

components.content:
-# PHOENIX RUSH · HELP
## Step by step
-# Some jobs need more than one command. Do them in this order.

**Log a Rush result**
**1.** `/rush log` – Opponent and score. Optional goals, assists and date.
**2.** `A manager confirms` – Managers’ own logs count straight away; everyone else waits for a manager.
**3.** `Add detail in the Squad Hub` – Teammates, ratings and a screenshot go on the site.
**4.** `/leaderboard mode:rush` – Confirmed results feed the Rush leaderboard (Stats bot).

**Find a game**
**1.** `/lfg now` – Say you are free, for how long, with an optional note.
**2.** `/lfg list` – See who else is looking.
**3.** `/lfg cancel` – Take yourself off when you are done.

**Run the queue (managers)**
**1.** `/queue settings` – Set what happens to players who fail to show.
**2.** `/queue board` – Posts the live queue board in the configured channel.
**3.** `/queue status` – Anyone can see the line.
**4.** `/queue remove · clear` – Take one player off, or empty the queue.

## /lfg
-# Everyone · Looking for Rush players: say you are available, or see who is

**Choose one**
• `/lfg now` – Post that you are available for Rush
   `minutes` – How long you are around (default 60, max 180)
   `note` – Position, mode, anything else
• `/lfg cancel` – Take your availability down
• `/lfg list` – Who is available for Rush right now

**Good to know**
Your answer expires. Use `cancel` to leave sooner.
